verdict.rationale: Codegen integrates with Linear, Jira, Clickup, and Monday.com, allowing the agent to update statuses, add comments, link PRs, and create new tasks directly tied to issues, and explicitly supports connecting a Linear workspace to enable agent interactions with issues — enabling a developer to assign work from an existing ticket. Missing for 10: a concrete end-to-end walkthrough or independent hands-on report showing a ticket-to-agent-task assignment flow in action, and Jira/Clickup/Monday specifics beyond a bullet mention.
